title: Entangled in Representations: Mechanistic Investigation of Cultural Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Probing internal representations using an activation patching method (Culturescope) to extract embedded cultural knowledge and calculate a Cultural Flattening (CF) score. The paper also measures bias intrinsically and extrinsically by analyzing model accuracy and internal attention contribution scores on multiple-choice questions (MCQs) designed with culturally nuanced hard negatives based on geographic regions and language resource levels.
